items.prompt: If the top and bottom of a fraction are the same, then the fraction has a value of one. So, I’m going to show you fractions equal to one, but part of each fraction is missing. My turn to say the fraction equal to one.
items.demo: *12D over 12D*. How do I know 12D over 12D equals one? Because the top and bottom are the same.

items.prompt: My turn again. What fraction equals one?
items.demo: *12 over 12*. How do I know it equals one? Because the top and bottom are the same.
